title: Keep credentials out of logs
why: Logs are broadly retained and accessible, so credentials and authentication material written there can become durable secrets exposure.
suggestion: Remove the sensitive value or replace it with an explicit redacted representation.
limitations: Only common logger methods containing credential-shaped identifiers on the same logical line are reported.
Request-object logging is left to the FastAPI-specific request-data rule to avoid duplicate findings.
Custom logger wrappers and redaction helpers are not inferred.
